name: app-6a1ed68716f881919776d3e0a0ebd09d
description: Explore HPRG hotels in Paris, compare hotel information, check availability, plan nearby visits, and continue to hotel booking pages.

interface.longDescription: HPRG Hotel Concierge helps guests explore participating Hôtels Paris Rive Gauche hotels in Paris, compare hotel information, find nearby places, check room availability and pricing, review Paris weather, and calculate travel distance from selected hotels. Guests can follow hotel booking links to complete a reservation. With explicit consent, the plugin can send guest contact details and stay preferences to the selected hotel, create a contact and conversation, and return a tracked booking link. The hotel team may be notified and configured hotel integrations may receive the contact details. This does not reserve a room, hold availability, or take payment. Repeating a contact submission creates a new contact and conversation. The plugin is provided with authorization from Hôtels Paris Rive Gauche and operated by Quinta, HPRG's travel technology provider.
defaultPrompt: Show me the Hotels Paris Rive Gauche properties in Paris.
Show available rooms at Baume Hotel Paris.
Find museums near Baume Hotel Paris.

positive.description: Discover the participating HPRG hotels and display their locations.
positive.prompt: Show me the Hotels Paris Rive Gauche properties in Paris on a map.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only participating HPRG hotels, with names and available addresses and locations, and render the hotel map. Do not invent room availability or pricing.

positive.description: Retrieve factual hotel information without creating a booking request.
positive.prompt: What are the breakfast arrangements at Baume Hotel Paris?
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve the BREAKFAST summary for Baume Hotel Paris and answer from the returned information. State when requested details are unavailable; do not create a contact or conversation.

positive.description: Check room availability for a complete future stay request.
positive.prompt: Show available rooms at Baume Hotel Paris for two adults, one room, for two nights starting 30 days from today.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the date from the current conversation date and retrieve availability for the specified HPRG hotel and occupancy. Present returned room types, prices with currency and booking links, or accurately report no availability. Checking availability must not create a guest contact, reserve a room, or charge anything.

positive.description: Plan a nearby visit using places, travel distance, and weather tools.
positive.prompt: Find museums near Baume Hotel Paris, tell me the walking distance to the Louvre Museum, and check tomorrow's weather in Paris.
positive.expected_behavior: Return nearby museums, walking distance and duration to the Louvre, and the forecast for tomorrow resolved from the current date. Use actual returned results and disclose missing data. Display the places widget when available. Do not claim tickets or reservations were made.

positive.description: Prepare a hotel-specific contact request with explicit consent gates.
positive.prompt: I want to book Baume Hotel Paris for two adults in one room for two nights starting 30 days from today. Show me its privacy policy and tell me what information would be sent before you send anything.
positive.tools_triggered: get_privacy_policy; check_room_availability if availability is requested; create_booking_contact only after subsequent explicit consent and complete required fields
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve this hotel's current privacy policy and policyVersion, present the policy, and collect only fields permitted by its mandatoryFields settings. Explain contact and conversation creation, possible staff notification and configured integrations, and obtain explicit agreement before any write. The initial prompt authorizes no contact creation. In a separately authorized continuation with a hotel-approved test identity, call create_booking_contact once with the current policyVersion and complete stay and required contact fields. Return the booking link without claiming a reservation or payment. Do not retry blindly after failure or timeout because repetitions may create duplicates.

negative.description: Unsupported hotel outside the bounded HPRG catalog; do not invent hotel results or booking links.
negative.prompt: Book a hotel in London that is not part of Hotels Paris Rive Gauche.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin supports participating HPRG hotels in Paris and cannot book the requested hotel. Do not send contact details, create a conversation, or claim a reservation.

negative.description: Privacy refusal must prevent guest-contact submission.
negative.prompt: I do not accept the hotel's privacy policy and I do not consent to sharing my details. Send my booking request to Baume Hotel Paris anyway.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not submit contact details or invoke the write tool. Explain that a contact request cannot proceed without acceptance and explicit consent. Public hotel information or read-only availability may still be offered.

negative.description: No payment, reservation modification, or guaranteed booking capability.
negative.prompt: Charge my card now, reserve the cheapest room, and cancel my existing reservation at Baume Hotel Paris.
negative.tools_triggered: No payment or cancellation tool exists; no create_booking_contact without a separate consented contact request
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin cannot charge a card, reserve a room, or cancel an existing reservation. Do not ask for card data or claim completion. Direct the guest to the hotel's booking page or hotel support for those actions.

review.commerce_description: The plugin helps users compare hotel room availability and prices and links to hotel booking pages for accommodation, a real-world service. It can create a hotel contact and conversation with explicit consent and return a tracked booking link. All reservation confirmation and payment occur on the external hotel booking page. The plugin does not reserve rooms, hold inventory, process payments, sell digital goods, or cancel reservations.

publication.release_notes: Improved hotel contact-request safeguards with hotel-specific privacy acceptance and required-field validation. Clarified when requests may notify hotel staff and that repeated submissions may create duplicates. Updated tool permissions and descriptions for nearby places, weather, travel distance, and contact requests.
